title: Worn meadow grass
subject: Subject: worn, short meadow grass on firm ground, about 3 m across, as on the camp's landing ground. Dry olive and straw-coloured grass, thin in places so warm brown earth shows through in soft irregular patches, a few small darker tufts and a scattering of tiny pale flowers, all spread evenly. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The grass ground of open meadows and clearings: the landing ground, the camp, any open grassy patch.

title: The Warm Road
subject: Subject: an old paved road of big flat flagstones, about 3 m across. Rounded, slightly irregular stones in lavender-grey and soft violet, worn smooth, with lighter moonlit tops and a little moss at the edges, laid close in rough rows. In the narrow seams between them glows a thin warm amber-orange light, like embers, spread evenly along every seam. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The Warm Road, everywhere it runs (the camp, the Ember Line road, the Warm Road fights).

title: Tent canvas
subject: Subject: plain heavy canvas cloth, as on the camp's two little A-frame tents, about 1 m across. Off-white and pale cream, a little weathered, with faint water stains, soft creases and a coarse woven grain. Only the cloth. Seen at night, lit softly by a campfire nearby.
use: The cloth of the tents in the camp (and any other canvas: awnings, covers).

title: Birch bark
subject: Subject: the bark of a silver birch trunk, seen flat, about 40 cm across. Chalky white bark with short black horizontal marks and thin dark rings, a few grey cracks and small darker patches, the grain running top to bottom. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows, so the white is a soft cool grey-white.
use: The trunks and branches of all the birch trees.

title: Turf hut roof
subject: Subject: the round turf roof of a small stone hut, seen from straight above: a low dome of rough grass, olive and golden-green, with small clumps of purple heather and orange-flowered gorse growing in it, the edge of the dome resting on a ring of grey stones. The whole round roof is in the picture. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The roof of the round stone hut in the camp.

title: Hut doorway
subject: Subject: the doorway of a round dry-stone hut, seen flat from the front. Rough grey stones round a low opening, a flat lintel stone with a round sun symbol carved over it, a wooden plank door with iron straps standing open to the right, warm firelight inside, a flat stone step at the foot. Show the doorway and a little of the wall round it.
use: The front door of the round hut in the camp.

title: Camp tent
subject: Subject: a small camp tent seen flat from the side: a sheet of off-white canvas thrown over a ridge pole, held up by crossed wooden poles at each end and pegged down with ropes, with rolled bedrolls and a dark blanket under it. The whole tent is in the picture.
use: The two tents in the camp.

title: Travel chest
subject: Subject: a travel chest seen flat from the front: dark brown wooden planks, iron bands and iron corners, a flat lid, a small iron lock plate in the middle. The whole chest is in the picture.
use: The chests round the camp fire.

title: Wooden crate
subject: Subject: a wooden supply crate seen flat from the front: pale brown planks with a dark frame round the edge and iron nails, slightly weathered. The whole crate is in the picture.
use: The crates by the hut (and any crate in the wilds).

title: Gorse bush
subject: Subject: one low gorse bush, seen from the side, about 1 m tall: dense dark-green spiky stems covered in small orange and golden-yellow flowers. Its base at the bottom. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: Gorse bushes all over the moor.

title: White starflowers
subject: Subject: one low tuft of tiny white wildflowers seen from the side, about 20 cm tall: thin dark-green stems and small leaves topped with many little white five-petalled flowers. Its base at the bottom. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The little white flowers dotted through the grass and heather.
